question: Is the historical accuracy rule still an alternative to the F1 gate?

The golden evaluation set is held out from prompt tuning. Development queries guide revisions. Run each query three times to estimate sampling spread. On tool timeout, abstain or ask for clarification; never use invalid evidence. A fallback model uses the same output contract.
